reports.seasonal_hint: What sold in the NEXT four weeks in past years (averaged, lunar-calendar shifts included), your stock now, and how much to order to match it.
reports.seasonal_lunar_hint: This item's demand follows the lunar calendar (moves about 11 days earlier each year); its history window is shifted to match.
backoffice.title: Back office
plugin.content.fallback_notice: This content isn't available in your language yet — showing what's there so far.
issuereport.title: Report an issue
issuereport.intro: Describe what happened by typing or recording a voice note (and optionally your screen), plus the till's recent logs. Saved on this till immediately — it's queued to upload once this shop is online.
issuereport.note_placeholder: Describe what happened, e.g. which screen, what you tapped… (or use voice below)
issuereport.description_required: Type a description or record a voice note.
issuereport.saved: Saved. It will upload automatically once this shop is online.
issuereport.save_error: Couldn't save the report — try again.
issuereport.logs_note: The till's recent warning/error logs are attached automatically.
issuereport.nav_ends_recording: Recording stops if you navigate to another page — send your report first.
issuereport.route_note: You can open the report panel from any screen with the 🐞 button in the top bar.
issuereport.my_reports.title: My reports
issuereport.my_reports.intro: Reports from this till — sent or still waiting to send — with their last-known status. Statuses refresh automatically when the shop is online; a report that hasn't uploaded yet shows as pending.
issuereport.my_reports.empty: No reports sent from this till yet. A report appears here as soon as you save it — whether or not it has uploaded yet.
issuereport.my_reports.more_not_shown: %d more report(s) not shown — check back once older ones are filed or discarded.
issuereport.status.failing_reason.not_re: This till isn't fully set up yet — finish enrolling it to send reports.
issuereport.status.failing_reason.other: Couldn't reach the cloud after several tries. It will keep retrying automatically.

plugins.status.broken_binary: This plugin's files are missing or unreadable on this till. Store-installed plugins are reinstalled automatically; a plugin imported from a file must be re-imported on this till.
pos.toast.tax_unavailable: Cannot complete the sale: the tax rate for "%s" is unavailable while its tax plugin is being repaired. Remove the item or try again in a moment.
pos.toast.tax_unavailable_all: Checkout is unavailable — the tax plugin is being repaired. Try again shortly.

countrysettings.title: Country settings
countrysettings.intro: Default currency, tax rate and archive-retention floor for each country. These become a new shop's starting values once setup reads from this table — for now, editing a country here does not change any shop already running.
countrysettings.new.title: Add a country
countrysettings.retention_help: The minimum number of days an archived batch may be kept, once this value is wired into automatic cleanup. Not enforced yet — archives are currently kept for a fixed minimum regardless of this setting. You can raise it, but not set it below the floor shown.
countrysettings.delete_help: Restoring a built-in country returns it to the values it shipped with. A country you added here is removed completely.
countrysettings.error.tax_invalid: Enter a tax rate of zero or more.
countrysettings.error.retention_invalid: Enter the retention period as a whole number of days.
countrysettings.error.below_floor: Archive retention cannot be set below the minimum. It can only be raised.
pos.toast.fiscal_never_configured: Sale not completed: this shop is set to record real sales for Germany, but no TSE (technical security device) is configured, so the till will not record this sale. Set up a TSE — your own hardware, your own cloud account, or a managed subscription — or ask an administrator to take the shop out of live-sales mode until it's ready.
pos.toast.fiscal_tse_failing: Sale not completed: the shop's TSE is currently reported as failing, so the till will not record this sale. An owner (admin) can grant a temporary, time-limited override, or try again once the TSE is working.
selforder.checkout.fiscal_blocked: Ordering here is unavailable right now — please order at the counter.
fiscal.banner.override_active: TSE override active — sales are being recorded without a TSE signature until
fiscal.chip_ok_title: This till's fiscal signing is healthy
fiscal.chip_degraded_title: The most recent sale on this till completed without a TSE signature
receipt.fiscal.unsigned_override: Recorded during a documented TSE outage, under a time-limited owner override.
receipt.fiscal.unsigned_signing: TSE unreachable — this receipt was recorded without a TSE signature and will not be signed later.
receipt.fiscal.unsigned_cannot_sign: This sale could not be signed as presented — the receipt was recorded without a TSE signature and will not be signed later.
